The moved-in credit route builds the exact command from the path, key and body.

A SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock on app.invoices, the lock autovacuum and ANALYZE take, refuses each NOWAIT attempt with no row written; released during the bounded retry the same command succeeds once, held through all four attempts it fails with CreditUnavailableError; exactly one command and one Credit afterwards.
A command that succeeds first runs once with no pause.
After SQLSTATE 55P03 the same command is replayed after pauses of 0.25 and 0.5 seconds.
At most three replays (four attempts) with pauses 0.25, 0.5 and 1 second; the last 55P03 propagates unchanged.
Errors other than 55P03 are never replayed.
Credit and Refund services replay the identical command in a new connection after 55P03.
Empty, NULL or other-Property lists return no restricted events; each list releases only its own kind for the Lease's Property.

On a Lease with three ordinary warnings, a Rent-nonpayment warning and an Initial Rent Due Date override, a leases.read user (also one holding the read grants only for another Property) sees neither hidden event and gets the same items, three pages and cursors as the pre-9f-5 timeline and Lease detail.
invoices.read shows Initial Rent Due Date overrides and rent_nonpayment.read shows Rent-nonpayment events; neither shows the other.
Cursor pages over ordinary and restricted events equal the full ordered timeline with no duplicates.
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER function, EXECUTE for the runtime role only, no PUBLIC EXECUTE, no runtime table privilege; inactive actor and invalid pages are refused.

The Lease detail and timeline routes pass Property lists built only from the actor's invoices.read and rent_nonpayment.read grants; leases.read alone passes none.
Labels the Initial Rent Due Date override and Rent-nonpayment events the server returns; synthetic fixtures only.

Draft, draft with terms and draft update reject an End Date that is not the last day of its month (30 May, 28 Feb 2028, 1 June) and write no Lease; month ends (31 May, 29 Feb 2028, 28 Feb 2027) and an open draft without dates are accepted.
No table constraint: an earlier draft row keeps its mid-month End Date, but signing it is refused with no sign command recorded; a month-end draft signs.
A Lease ending 31 August gets its Initial Invoice but no recurring Rent Invoice for September; a Lease ending 30 September gets September Rent.

Migration 20261011_76 changes only the Lease draft, draft-with-terms, draft-update and sign functions (grants and SECURITY DEFINER kept), adds no table or constraint, runs the check after the idempotent replay and is forward-only.
Staff without financial.approve, or an approver of another Property, cannot reject; an approver rejects once with a reason, an exact replay returns the same result, and any later decision is refused.
A direct call through the financial role without the financial.approve reference is refused (42501), before and after the draft is decided; an exact approved repeat replays.

Withdrawal needs the draft's own prepare capability (final_settlements.prepare here) and the preparer's identity, before and after the decision; another Staff member or another capability is refused; the exact repeat replays.

The internal confirm record needs the financial.approve reference (42501 otherwise) and the matching draft kind (22023 otherwise), keeps the preparer and the confirmer (here the same approver), and a second decision is refused.

UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on drafts and decisions are refused; runtime and financial roles have no table access and no EXECUTE on internal helpers; reject and withdraw are granted only to the financial role and reads only to the runtime role; PUBLIC has no EXECUTE.
Reads need financial.approve or a prepare capability; unknown drafts are not found; state filter and page limit work; an inactive account cannot read.
Migration 20261012_77 adds only the two draft tables and draft functions, leaves every earlier function unchanged and is forward-only.
A draft kind paired with another kind's prepare capability is refused (23514); Final Settlement and correction drafts need final_settlements.prepare.
Without financial.approve a reader sees only the kinds its capabilities may prepare; a draft is never read, rejected or withdrawn through another Property.
A blank, padded or missing reason is refused by the service and directly by the database (22023) for both reject and withdraw, and no decision is written.
A non-datetime page cursor and a non-text prepare capability raise FinancialDraftInvalidError.
The list starts with Cash and Bank transfer; only property.manage adds or deactivates a method; an inactive method cannot be used; code and name never change and no method is deleted.

A Payment Refund draft changes no balance and creates no Refund; Staff cannot confirm (service or direct call); the approver's confirmation creates the USD Refund and records method, reference note, preparer and confirmer; replay is exact and another approver gets a conflict.
When an earlier confirmation used the available value, a second draft for the same value is refused at confirmation and stays pending.
A qualified Pet Deposit Refund draft creates nothing until confirmed; confirmation pays the Pet Deposit Customer and keeps the reference note.
Runtime and financial roles cannot execute the direct Refund functions or read the new tables; a direct call is refused (42501) and creates no Refund.
Migration 20261013_78 adds only the two tables and new functions, leaves every earlier function body unchanged and is forward-only.
POST /refund-drafts needs refunds.create for the source Property, CSRF and an Idempotency-Key; it records only a draft with the method and reference note and never confirms.

Confirming over HTTP needs financial.approve for the Property and CSRF; refunds.create alone is refused without dispatch; the response is the Refund body with its Location; a decided draft gives 409 without private detail.
A second Pet Deposit Refund draft for value already refunded is refused at confirmation (422 class) and stays pending.
Only property.manage turns a method off; afterwards an exact draft repeat still replays, a new draft is refused and the pending draft cannot be confirmed.
A Customer Credit Refund draft leaves the Credit available until confirmed; confirmation pays the Credit Customer and reduces the Credit.
A draft whose id equals an earlier Refund command key of the approver is refused at confirmation and creates no second Refund.
The draft id is stable for one Property, person, Refund kind and key, and differs when any of them differs.
A Payment Refund draft becomes stale when the payer gets a new unpaid Invoice; confirmation is refused as a stale draft (422 class), no Refund is created and the draft stays pending.
A direct database call with an empty, padded or 501-character reference note, or a source kind other than PAYMENT or CREDIT, is refused (P5202) and records no draft.
A REFUND draft whose variant is not USD or PET is refused at confirmation and creates no Refund.

With the written agreement recorded on the draft, the confirmed Pet Deposit Refund names the other Signer as recipient; the agreement is append-only; the Primary Tenant's ledger shows the Pet Deposit leaving and names the Signer who was paid.
Without an agreement the Pet Deposit Refund goes to the Primary Tenant and the ledger row has no paid-to Signer, as before.

A non-Signer or the Primary Tenant as named recipient is refused; a missing, empty, padded or over-long agreement or a Payment Refund with a recipient is refused (P5202); a Refund row naming another Signer without a recorded agreement is refused by the database.

Migration 20261014_79 adds only the agreement table, changes only the Pet Refund source check and the Refund confirm function among earlier functions, keeps the ledger view columns and is forward-only.
POST /refund-drafts refuses a Signer recipient without the agreement, an agreement without a recipient, or a recipient on a Payment Refund (422), and passes both to the Pet Refund draft.

For the seeded Payment and Pet Deposit Refunds and every other Refund or Refund correction already in the database without a Signer agreement, the rebuilt ledger books the recipient and adds no paid-to field, exactly as the revision 48 projection did. The upgrade's refusal when an earlier Deposit Refund was paid to someone else is a defensive precondition and is not tested (the earlier Pet Refund source trigger prevents seeding such a row).

POST /reservations/{id}/deposit-drafts derives the draft kind from the cancellation responsibility: a Customer-caused cancellation gives a forfeiture draft under reservation_deposits.dispose, a Property-caused one a Refund draft under reservation_deposits.refund with the Refund method and reference note; an actor holding only the other capability is refused (404) and nothing is recorded.
The Reservation Deposit draft route refuses an ACTIVE Reservation (422), a request without the CSRF token (403) and a Refund method without its reference note (422) before any service call.

A Staff actor holding reservations.read, reservation_deposits.dispose and reservation_deposits.correct cannot confirm a Reservation Deposit draft (404); a financial.approve holder confirms it with the CSRF token, and the confirm call is bound to the Reservation in the path.
A Reservation outcome correction draft needs reservation_deposits.correct and the capability of the replacement kind; with either one missing the route answers 404 and records nothing.

GET /properties/{id}/reservation-deposit-decisions needs reservations.read, refuses a page size over 100 and a malformed cursor (422), answers private no-store, and passes the opaque next cursor back as the time and Reservation identity of the last item.

Staff cancellation releases the Unit and records no Deposit outcome; the Reservation is on the waiting list with its held amount; the Staff forfeiture draft changes no balance; Staff cannot confirm (service and database refuse); the financial.approve holder's confirmation records the full forfeiture once, replays exactly, and removes the Reservation from the list.

Owner answer of 2026-10-04: the expiry command (the one the worker runs) cancels and releases the Unit but never forfeits; the expired Reservation stays on the waiting list while a draft is pending and after a draft is rejected, and leaves it only when a forfeiture draft is confirmed.

A Property-caused cancellation waits for a Refund draft that must carry a Refund method and reference note; on confirmation the full received amount is refunded in USD to the Reservation Customer, with the approver as processor and the method and note recorded against the draft.

A Reservation Deposit draft is refused for an ACTIVE Reservation, for a kind that does not follow the cancellation responsibility, for a Refund number already used, and while another draft for the same Reservation is pending; an exact repeat replays the first draft.

Owner answer to Q-2026-10-04-5: a receipt reversal is refused (55000) while a Reservation Deposit draft is pending; after the preparer withdraws it the reversal works as before, the Reservation leaves the waiting list, no longer reads AWAITING_DECISION, and a new draft is refused because nothing is held.

A Reservation outcome correction is a draft that needs reservation_deposits.correct and the current outcome; until a financial.approve holder confirms it the original forfeiture stays active and unreversed; confirmation adds the linked reversal and the replacement forfeiture and keeps the original row unchanged.

The financial role can no longer run the one-call cancel, expire and outcome correction functions; it runs the new cancel, expire, draft and confirm functions, which the runtime role cannot; only the runtime role reads the waiting list; PUBLIC runs none of them; the list refuses page sizes outside 1 to 100 and a half cursor. PUBLIC, prm_runtime, prm_financial and prm_bootstrap run none of the four internal helpers or the four retired functions; the reject and withdraw functions are financial-role only.
The same command key with a changed reason, or reused for a correction draft, is refused as a reused key and records nothing; the exact repeat replays the first draft.

Staff prepares, a second person holding financial.approve confirms, and a third approver's later confirmation is refused as a conflict; the draft records preparer and approver, and the forfeiture names the approver as actor.
Two Deposit drafts for one Reservation recorded at the same moment with different keys leave exactly one draft; the other is refused as a conflict.
A reused Reservation Deposit draft key answers 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED with rule API-016.
A Reservation whose receipt was reversed before cancellation is cancelled without AWAITING_DECISION (PENDING_V1_031 in the command result and the Reservation read) and is not on the waiting list.
A cancelled Reservation whose Refund was fully returned and whose receipt was unwound keeps reading PENDING_V1_031, not AWAITING_DECISION, and is not on the waiting list.

Only a financial.approve holder rejects (service and database refuse Staff); only the preparer withdraws; a reason is required; repeats replay; a withdrawn draft cannot be confirmed; no outcome is recorded, the Deposit stays held and the Reservation stays on the waiting list with no pending draft.

A Reservation Deposit draft cannot be confirmed or rejected through another Reservation or under another Property id; the slice 3a Refund confirm refuses it; the Reservation confirm and reject refuse a slice 3a Refund draft; nothing is recorded.
The reject route needs financial.approve, the withdraw route the draft kind's prepare capability; both need a reason and the CSRF token and answer private no-store.

A recorded move-out allows one Unit cleaning charge per Lease for the Primary Tenant, equal to the Unit's current rate; a later rate change leaves the recorded charge unchanged; the issued Invoice is due on the issue date plus the Property's configured days; replay returns the same charge; rates and charges are append-only and audited. The id of another one-time charge cannot be reused for a cleaning charge. The cleaning charge is a one-time charge source, not a recurring Service (BR-SVC-001 amendment).

The cleaning charge Invoice accepts the existing authorized Due Date override with a reason. Only a holder of invoices.adjust can reduce it, and only with a reason: a user without invoices.adjust is refused and a blank reason is rejected by the Adjustment command; an authorized credit Adjustment with a reason reduces it while the charge source, rate snapshot and Invoice line keep their amounts.

No cleaning charge when the Customer never moved in, before the move-out is recorded, when the Unit has no rate, when the rate is zero, when the expected rate is no longer current, for an unknown Lease id in the Property, or under an unknown Property; nothing is recorded.

A Unit cleaning rate needs property.manage, supersedes exactly the current rate of the same Unit, replays by identity, refuses identity reuse, negative amounts, an unknown Unit id in the Property and an unknown Property; a database insert that supersedes another Unit's rate is refused; it can be read with invoices.create or property.manage.
The runtime role executes only the rate set and read functions, the financial role only the charge function; neither role has table access or the internal snapshot functions.
Migration 20261016_81 follows 20261015_80 and refuses downgrade.
The rate command accepts integer USD cents from zero, refuses negative, float and boolean amounts, nil identities and unnormalized reasons; the charge command refuses nil identities.

Setting a rate needs property.manage, recording the charge needs invoices.create in the same Property, and reading the rate needs invoices.create or property.manage; refusals happen before any database connection.
The rate set, rate read and cleaning charge database functions refuse a disabled user account (P4506) and record nothing; the service read maps it to an authorization error.

After a verified voluntary early termination with a hand-back on 3 August, the unpaid August monthly Rent Invoice is assessed as VOID without showing Lease, move-out or date identities, and an invoices.void holder VOIDs the whole Invoice, Rent and Trash Collection lines, with a reason; invoices.adjust alone, a mismatched expected action and a mismatched expected outstanding amount are refused; replay returns the same result; key reuse (other reason or other Invoice) and a second resolution are refused; lines keep their amounts; the append-only resolution links the move-out record, the VOID event and its own audit event.

A Payment on the Rent line and Customer Credit on the Trash line both count as paid; an invoices.adjust holder removes the unpaid rest of each line with one linked credit Adjustment per line (Rent and Trash) and a reason, leaving nothing outstanding; the Payment and Credit applications are unchanged and invoices.void alone is refused. Each Adjustment references the resolution, not the move-out record.

A hand-back on or after the 25th covers the next month's monthly Rent Invoice only: unpaid it is VOIDed; fully paid it is kept as issued and the command records nothing (BR-RENT-026 amendment, Q-2026-10-04-9); the hand-back month's own Invoice is not covered.

The rule refuses a non-voluntary termination, hand-backs on the 5th and the 24th, the Initial Rent Invoice, a Lease without a recorded move-out, a wrong Invoice version, an expected action that no longer matches after a Payment, an assessment without both invoices.read and leases.read, an unknown Property (P4501) and a disabled account (P4506); nothing is VOIDed, adjusted or recorded.
The runtime role executes only the assessment, the financial role only the resolution command; neither has access to the resolution table or the trigger function.
Migration 20261017_82 follows 20261016_81 and refuses downgrade.
The hand-back command accepts only VOID or CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT, needs a normalized reason and a positive version, and refuses a nil key.

VOID needs invoices.void and the credit Adjustment needs invoices.adjust in the same Property; the assessment needs both invoices.read and leases.read because it reveals the termination basis and move-out window; refusals happen before any database connection.

The date that counts is the actual move-out date of the current physical move-out record: a termination dated the 10th with a move-out on the 3rd is covered, and a move-out on the 10th corrected to the 2nd becomes covered and the resolution links the correcting record.

A voluntary early termination with a recorded notice dated 26 August (which would point at September) and a move-out on 3 August covers the August Invoice and not the September Invoice: the notice date is ignored (BR-RENT-030).

A never-moved-in unpaid-Initial resolution with a partly paid Initial Invoice that has a Rent line and Trash Collection lines credits each line's unpaid rest with its own credit Adjustment and leaves the Invoice PAID; without the fix it failed (slice 6 run 2) (owner answer to Q-2026-10-04-10 (a)).

A voluntary early termination gives a BR-DEP-023 forfeiture draft of the whole held Security Deposit under deposits.dispose; nothing changes until a financial.approve holder confirms; the preparer without financial.approve and a wrong database reference are refused; replays return the same result; a second pending draft and a Pet Deposit draft are refused.
A BR-DEP-022 pet noncompliance termination forfeits both the Security and the Pet Deposit, each in full, through confirmed drafts.

A BR-LEASE-025 violation termination gives a BR-LEASE-025 Security forfeiture draft of the whole held amount and refuses the Pet Deposit (BR-DEP-027 at Final Settlement); confirming the draft forfeits the whole held amount; a BR-LEASE-028 termination without a recorded Serious Default event and a termination under another clause are refused because the ground cannot be worked out.
The never-moved-in unpaid-Initial resolution no longer forfeits the Security Deposit, which still holds money; a confirmed forfeiture draft forfeits it, with ground BR-LEASE-005.
A physical move-out correction is refused with an error naming the hand-back resolution that relies on the record, and nothing is recorded (owner answer to Q-2026-10-04-10 b).

Only the financial role executes the forfeiture draft record and confirm functions; the internal source function is executable by neither application role; the financial, runtime and bootstrap roles and PUBLIC cannot execute the retired one-call Lease disposition functions (migrations 27 and 58) or the Lease disposition reversal (migration 28) (owner answers to Q-2026-10-04-12 and Q-2026-10-04-13).

After the Customer moved in, an unpaid-Initial (BR-LEASE-005) termination gives a BR-LEASE-005 forfeiture draft of the whole held Security Deposit, and the confirmed draft forfeits it (BR-DEP-026: kept whether or not the Customer moved in).

A BR-LEASE-028 termination with a THIRTY_DAY_SERIOUS_DEFAULT event recorded for the Lease on or before the termination date gives a BR-LEASE-028 forfeiture draft of the whole held Security Deposit, and the confirmed draft forfeits it (owner answer to Q-2026-10-04-11, 2). A Serious Default event of another Lease gives no ground: that Lease's draft is refused.

A reused command key with a changed request, a disposition id already used by a recorded disposition or held by another pending forfeiture draft, an unknown Property (record and confirm; the schema holds one Property), a confirm naming another Deposit, an unknown Deposit, a reason the confirmation would refuse (direct database call) and a draft made stale by a later Deposit change are all refused; nothing is forfeited and the draft stays undecided.

After a correction gives Deposit value back and the line owes again, the shared DL-032 step applies the Customer's own Credit first, then the Security Deposit, and refunds only what remains in each Deposit; every record is linked to the correction before it is written, the Credit application is a Settlement Credit application under financial.approve whose one-call reversal is refused, the Deposit application takes the Settlement's next order number, each Deposit Refund keeps its Deposit in its correction details row, both Deposits end empty, the closed Settlement row is unchanged and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2).

A plan key naming a released Payment allocation resolves to the Credit the correction's own credit Adjustment recognized; that released Credit pays its Customer's open pet damage before the Pet Deposit, the Pet Deposit pays the rest and its rest is refunded; a draft whose allocation the correction did not release is stale and stays pending (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2). The 10c-1b Credit Refund check accepts a correction's Credit Refund (here to the payer) only when its details name no Deposit (DB-REFUND-001; wording corrected after review round 2).

The correction plan check refuses an open Settlement, Credit not used before a Deposit pays, released Credit left while its Customer owes, a Deposit Refund while debt remains, a Deposit not emptied, steps out of the DL-032 order, a Deposit of the wrong type for its step, a Pet Deposit first step on a line that is not pet damage, a Pet Deposit Refund before open pet damage is paid, the remaining Pet Deposit while the Security Deposit holds money, mixed Refund details, a Refund to another Customer without the agreement, a Deposit that holds nothing, malformed or foreign overlays and plans, and a waiting draft on a Settlement source (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2; the order, type and pet damage refusals added after review round 2).

After closure a Settlement Credit application, a Deposit application and a Deposit Refund stay refused unless they are the own record of a correction confirmed in the same transaction, written or processed by its approver, matching a step of its plan once (the deferred Credit check refuses a step written twice; a Deposit application off the plan or beyond its steps is refused), in the DL-032 order (Credit before Deposit applications before Refunds; no Security Deposit step after a remaining Pet Deposit step), once per Deposit (the details key), with the BR-REFUND-015 recipient (the Primary Tenant without an agreement, another Customer only as a signed Signer with it), an active Refund method (BR-REFUND-014), no waiting receipt reversal draft and no open debt a Deposit could pay; details naming another Deposit, or a Credit Refund whose details name a Deposit, are refused; the step runs only inside its correction, for that correction's approver and at READ COMMITTED (both added after review round 2), and a draft whose recorded result differs in any field is stale; each refusal leaves the draft pending (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2).

No role may execute the new internal functions or read or write the correction Refund details; the two new details columns are nullable, an agreement needs a Deposit and each Deposit is refunded at most once per correction; no time limit; the migration is forward-only, adds only the listed functions and changes only the seven relaxed or extended checks and writers (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2).

With two Signers after closure, the Signer's Credit is refused on the Primary Tenant's line, the Primary Tenant's own Credit must pay before the Pet Deposit while the Signer's Credit is not required because the Signer owes nothing, and the rest of the Pet Deposit is refunded to the signed Signer with the written agreement of all Signers kept in the correction's details row; both ledgers reconcile (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2).

After a correction gives the Pet Deposit a Late-payment Charge's amount back, the step pays the Charge with the Customer's Credit first (direct Charge basis) and then with the Pet Deposit after the pet damage; a Credit application, a Deposit application or a Deposit Refund of one Settlement linked to a correction of another Settlement is refused (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2).

The step locks the Lease row FOR UPDATE, as the move-out inspection command does, so an inspection correction that supersedes the inspection waits while a correction pays a pet damage line from the Pet Deposit; after the inspection is superseded the line is no longer pet damage and the Pet Deposit cannot pay it as pet damage; the draft stays pending and nothing is written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2, owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-43). Since sub-slice 10c-2a-4 (owner exception, owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-50; the name is kept and its last words describe the earlier behaviour): the waiting supersede waits on the Lease row itself (not on the Settlement row the step also holds), reads the closed Settlement after the Lease lock and is refused (P5S01) with nothing written; the line stays pet damage and the step pays it from the Pet Deposit as pet damage.

After closure at an unpaid-Initial termination the correction plan refuses the remaining Pet Deposit on other debt by a staff reason; with the Customer's choice the step writes the pet damage and remaining Pet Deposit applications, and the Pet Deposit's rest is refunded while other debt stays open, accepted by both the plan check and the correction's Deposit Refund source check; the kept Security Deposit holds nothing and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2, owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-43).

After the correction reverses the Settlement's Credit applications on an Invoice with a Rent line and two Service lines, the correction plan refuses Credit steps that do not follow the Rent-first proposal without the Customer's designation; the step writes a designated step as CUSTOMER_DESIGNATED with the designation text and the other steps as the Rent-first proposal (RENT_FIRST_PROPOSAL, SERVICE_PROPOSAL), as the correction's Credit check requires; the Invoice is paid again and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-2, owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-43).

A Refund correction of a line two Deposit applications and a Credit application paid at closure reverses the Deposit applications newest first, writes the linked credit Adjustment and runs the shared DL-032 step: the Customer's Credit first, the Security Deposit pays what the line still owes, and only the rest of each Deposit is refunded; without a plan the step refuses the draft; the released Deposit value never becomes Customer Credit; every record is linked, the audit names them, the Settlement row is unchanged, the ledger reconciles and a repeat replays (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).

Owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-07-42, both cases: with no open debt on the Lease the released Credit is refunded as before; once the Customer owes a charge issued after closure, a Refund correction without a plan is refused, and with the plan the released Credit pays that charge first and only the rest is refunded (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).

Owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-07-41 and answer 2 to Q-2026-10-07-42: a line paid at closure by the Pet Deposit and after closure by a Payment is refunded in part; the release takes the newest Payment allocation whole and then part of the older Deposit application, reversed whole; the released Payment value becomes the Customer's Credit and pays that Customer's debt before the Deposit, the Pet Deposit pays the rest of the line by a new Customer choice and its rest is refunded while the unpaid Initial Rent stays; no other line changes how it is paid and no Credit is refunded; a plan in which the Pet Deposit pays before that Credit is refused (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3, review rounds 1 and 2).

Owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-48 (the case the 10c-1b tests 5 and 6 covered before their rebuild): a 1,500 charge issued after closure, 1,000 paid, refunded for 1,200: the unpaid 500 is removed, the Payment allocation is reversed whole, 300 re-posted, 700 recognized as the Customer's Credit and refunded; the line's charge is 300, fully paid (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).

Owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-48: a line paid 7,500 by the Pet Deposit that still owes 5,000 is refunded for 6,000: the unpaid 5,000 is removed, 1,000 is released, the Pet Deposit application is reversed whole (7,500 back to the Pet Deposit), the overlay equals the state after the release (the line owes 6,500), the plan pays 6,500 from the Pet Deposit by a new Customer choice and refunds 1,000; no Credit, no other line changed (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).

Owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-46: a Refund correction releases only the line's newest Deposit application, the older one on the same line stays active and the correction's own Adjustment passes the 8a-1 refusal; an unlinked Adjustment stays refused, one linked but written by another person is refused by 8a-1, and a linked one that would leave the line paid above its new amount is refused at commit (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3). Sub-slice 10c-3c-1 (owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-10-69, the approved hardening): the approver's linked Adjustment of the hand-built correction, whose draft names no obligation, is now refused by 8a-1 (55000); the commit-time check is kept in test_settlement_correction_allow_hardening_migration.py.

Owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-46: at closure the remaining Pet Deposit, by the Customer's choice, paid both Service lines and part of the Rent line of one Initial Invoice, and the rest of the Rent stayed as debt; a Refund of one Service line reverses only its application, the applications on the other lines of the same Invoice stay active, the correction's own Adjustment passes the 8a-1 refusal, and the released value pays the Rent still owed under a new Customer choice for this correction, so nothing is refunded (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).

Owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-07-44: at an unpaid-Initial termination a correction that uses the remaining Pet Deposit for other debt is refused with the Customer choice recorded at the Settlement and accepted with a new choice; the released pet damage value is applied again, the remaining Pet Deposit pays the other line and its rest is refunded while other debt stays open; a later correction that reuses that correction's choice text is refused (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3, review round 1).

Owner answer 4 to Q-2026-10-07-44: the Refund correction's confirm locks the Lease row FOR UPDATE after the two draft locks and before the first source Payment, so another session's lock on the Lease is refused while it runs; every other lock is taken by the step's lock function, which takes the released sources' Payments and Credits in its single id-ordered passes and the corrected Invoice FOR UPDATE after the Charges, also when no step pays that Invoice, so a confirm waiting on a step Credit's Payment holds no lock on that Invoice (review rounds 1 and 2); the shared step takes the same Lease lock when no variant did; a correction Credit application whose basis is not its step's is refused (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3, round-3 hardening of 10c-2a-2).

No role may execute the two new internal functions; the Refund correction's record and confirm keep their financial-role grant only; the migration is forward-only, adds only the two functions and changes only the eight listed functions; no time limit (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-3).
The inspection service reports the database refusal of a supersede on a Lease whose Final Settlement is closed (P5S01) as a conflict, not as an unknown outcome (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4).

After a real closure a supersede of the inspection the Settlement relied on is refused as a conflict (P5S01) and writes no inspection, finding, command or audit row; the inspection stays current and its pet damage line stays pet damage; damage found after closure is a separate inspection, accepted and current next to the earlier one; a supersede of that later inspection is refused too; an exact repeat replays (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, owner answers to Q-2026-10-07-44 and Q-2026-10-08-49).

Before the Final Settlement closes a supersede is accepted as before; after the closure an exact repeat of that supersede replays its saved response and writes nothing, and a supersede of the superseding inspection is refused (P5S01) and writes nothing (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, review round 1).

The BEFORE INSERT trigger repeats the refusal: a superseding row inserted directly is refused outside READ COMMITTED (55000); at READ COMMITTED it passes the trigger before closure (and fails only at the deferred completion check) and is refused by it after closure (P5S01) (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-51).

The gap found in review round 1: a REPEATABLE READ transaction whose snapshot was taken before the Final Settlement existed still sees no Settlement row after the Settlement starts and closes; its supersede after closure is refused because it does not run at READ COMMITTED (55000), and nothing is written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-51).

A supersede outside READ COMMITTED is refused (55000) before closure too, at REPEATABLE READ and SERIALIZABLE, with nothing written; an inspection that supersedes nothing is not affected; the same supersede at READ COMMITTED is accepted while the Settlement is open (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-51).

A supersede that starts while the Settlement confirm holds the Lease row lock waits on that Lease row (not on the Settlement row) and, once the confirm commits the closure, is refused (P5S01) with nothing written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4, review round 1).

The inspection command keeps its financial-role grant only and the trigger function has none; the migration is forward-only and changes only the bodies of those two functions (security, settings, privileges and owner kept); the refusal reads the Settlement row FOR SHARE after the Lease row lock (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-4).

The pet classification correction command takes a true or false classification, an evidence reference and a reason that fit the classification record, and a plan of typed steps (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

Only final_settlements.prepare records and only financial.approve confirms a pet classification correction; the record call carries the line, the corrected classification, the evidence and the DL-032 plan (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).
A pet classification correction whose sources changed is stale and stays pending; other refusals keep the Final Settlement error mapping (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

To not pet damage: the line's Pet-Deposit-first application is reversed, the Customer's Credit pays first, the remaining Pet Deposit pays the rest at step 5 on a staff reason and its last 300 is refunded; the classification record is linked and the reader follows it; the inspection and the closed Settlement are unchanged; ledgers reconcile; an exact repeat replays (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5, owner answer to Q-2026-10-07-45).

The draft's plan is checked under the corrected classification before the record exists (a Pet Deposit pet damage step on the line corrected to not pet damage is refused at record), and at a normal end the Pet Deposit's value may not be refunded while the line it can pay still owes; nothing is written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

At a BR-DEP-027 termination with no Customer choice for the correction, the Pet Deposit value released from the line corrected to not pet damage is refunded to the Primary Tenant and the line stays open debt (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).
To pet damage while no Pet Deposit holds money: nothing is reversed, only the classification record is written, and the line's applications and the Deposits are unchanged (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

To pet damage while the Pet Deposit holds money: the line's Security Deposit application is reversed, the Customer's Credit pays first, the Pet Deposit pays the pet damage lines first, the Security Deposit the rest and its rest is refunded; the remaining Pet Deposit application stays (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

Carried from sub-slice 10c-2a-4 review round 2: the shared step's own pet-damage re-check refuses through the step (55000) when a later correction changed the line's classification after the draft; the draft stays pending and nothing is written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

Owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-07-44: at a BR-DEP-027 termination the remaining Pet Deposit pays the line corrected to not pet damage only by a Customer choice given for this correction; neither the Final Settlement's choice nor an earlier correction's is reused, at record and again at the confirm, where of two drafts recorded while both were pending with the same choice the second is refused and stays pending (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5, review round 1).

Refusals: the same classification, a line that is not a Damage line billed from a finding, a line of another Invoice, a Settlement still open, a line of another Lease, malformed input; Staff cannot confirm; READ COMMITTED only; replay and reused key; a draft whose sources changed is stale and stays pending (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5).

No role may read or write the classification table or run the internal functions; the record and confirm are granted to the financial role only; the migration is forward-only, adds the table, its three triggers and the listed functions, and changes only the five listed functions with their privileges kept; the confirm takes its locks in the 8e-3 order and the lock function takes this variant's line Invoice (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5, review round 1).

The DB-SETTLE-007 insert check: a record is accepted only linked to its own correction confirmed in this transaction and exactly as its draft prepared it; unlinked, another line, classification, evidence, reason or person, a time before the correction or at the line's latest record are refused (23514), each by its own clause; the confirm dates its record after the line's latest record; the table is append-only (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5, review rounds 1 and 2).

A Damage line billed from an inspection superseded before closure (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-5, review round 2; renamed in sub-slice 10c-2a-7 under owner answers (a) to Q-2026-10-08-53, Q-2026-10-11-80 and Q-2026-10-11-85, the hand-closed setup kept): the change to not pet damage is refused as the same classification and nothing is recorded; the change to pet damage is recorded and confirmed with the full DL-032 steps (Credit 400, Pet Deposit 12,500 on the pet line, Security Deposit 10,000 and the remaining Pet Deposit 2,100 on a staff reason on the other line, the Pet Deposit's 5,400 refunded), checked to the cent.

At a BR-DEP-027 termination a Refund correction and a pet classification correction recorded while both are pending carry the same new Customer choice; the classification is confirmed first and leaves every balance as it was; the Refund confirm is refused in the shared step (55000), stays pending and writes nothing; the same Refund with a choice given for it confirms (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-6, owner answer 1 to Q-2026-10-08-52).

The Customer choice re-check sits in the shared step after its locks and before the stale comparison; the migration is forward-only and changes only that function, its new body exactly the old one with the single replacement, keeping its owner, SECURITY DEFINER, settings and privileges; no role may call it (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-6, review round 1).

A correction built by hand whose plan reuses the Final Settlement's own Customer choice text is refused by the shared step (55000); the draft stays pending, no correction is written and every balance stays (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2a-6, review round 1).

A returned-Refund correction command needs a positive returned amount in cents, a timezone-aware return date, trimmed return references and reason, both or neither of the new Refund's method and note, and typed plan steps (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1).

Only final_settlements.prepare records and only financial.approve confirms a returned-Refund correction; the record call carries the Refund, the returned amount, the return date and references, the new Refund or none, and the DL-032 plan (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1).
A returned-Refund correction draft whose Refund or Credit changed is stale and stays pending; other database refusals keep the Final Settlement error mapping (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1).

The one-call verified return of a correction's Credit Refund and a direct Refund correction row are refused; a REFUND_RETURN draft has no effect and Staff cannot confirm it (the service, and the database for any other authorization reference or a billing service identity; the recorder takes only final_settlements.prepare); the confirm writes the verified return under financial.approve, linked first, and a new Refund of the returned amount to the same Customer with the draft's method and note; neither the return nor the new Refund is corrected with one call; the Settlement row is unchanged and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1, owner answer 4 to the 10c-1b review record and answers 1 and 4 to Q-2026-10-08-55).

A returned Credit first pays its own Customer's open debt on the Lease, whether or not a new Refund is paid: a return without a plan is refused while the Customer owes a charge, with or without a new Refund; with the plan the Credit pays part of the charge and the new Refund asked for is not paid as nothing is left; a return-only correction pays more; a last return with a new Refund pays the rest of the charge first and refunds only what is left, each amount to the cent (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1, owner answers 1 and 2 to Q-2026-10-08-55, review round 2).

A correction's Credit Refund of value released from a third-party Payment comes back in part: a return-only correction leaves the Credit with its Customer; a later return pays a new Refund to the Invoice Customer, not the payer; a second linked Refund of 1 cent beyond what that correction returned is refused although the Credit still holds value (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1, owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-08-55).

A returned-Refund correction refuses a Refund no correction paid, an unknown Refund, more than the net value, a return dated before the Refund or in the future, a Deposit Refund step without a new Refund, malformed input, an impossible return date or offset (22023) and a reused key; a second draft on the same Refund is stale after the first and stays pending; the confirm runs at READ COMMITTED and holds the Lease row and the returned Refund's Credit until it commits (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1).

For a correction's Refund the Refund correction check accepts only the verified return of its own REFUND_RETURN correction: inside a correction confirmed by hand a linked row with another amount, another actor, the one-call reference, another return date, another correction Refund, another method reference or other evidence than the draft's is refused, the draft's own row passes but a second return in the same correction is refused, and a financial.approve row outside a correction is refused; after a real return no row reverses it, linked or not, under either reference (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1, review rounds 1 and 2).

Only the financial role records and confirms a returned-Refund correction; no role calls its internal functions; the migration adds only its functions, changes only the four patched functions (each new body exactly the old one with its replacements, privileges, owner, SECURITY DEFINER and settings kept) and is forward-only (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-1).

A Final Settlement Deposit Refund is not returned with one call; a return-only correction writes the verified return under financial.approve, linked first, and the Deposit holds the returned amount again; no step runs, so no Credit, Deposit application or Refund is written; a return-only form refuses a plan; the Settlement row is unchanged and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-07-42).

A returned Settlement Deposit Refund with a new Refund runs the shared DL-032 step: without a plan it is refused; with the plan the Customer's own Credit pays first, the remaining Pet Deposit pays the rest of the open debt, and only what is left is refunded from the Deposit, each amount to the cent (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-08-55).
A Deposit Refund paid by a post-settlement correction is not returned with one call; a return-only correction gives part of it back to its Deposit (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a).

On the real path, a Pet Deposit holds money again after its Settlement Refund came back; a pet classification correction to pet damage then reverses the line's Security Deposit application, and the plan pays the line with the Customer's own Credit first, the Pet Deposit as pet damage and the Security Deposit, refunding the Security Deposit's rest (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 5 to Q-2026-10-08-52).

Once the Final Settlement is closed, a receipt reversal draft for a Lease Deposit receipt is refused at record as a conflict (P5S01), and a receipt reversal row written directly is refused unless a correction of that Settlement links it (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 5 to Q-2026-10-08-55, approved tightening).

The migration replaces only the returned-Refund correction functions and patches the Refund correction check, the receipt reversal recorder and trigger, the forfeiture recorder and disposition check, the plan check and the step (each new body exactly the old one with its replacements); every changed function keeps its owner, SECURITY DEFINER, settings and privileges; only the financial role records and confirms (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a).

While a Deposit holds returned money that no debt can take, a return-only correction of a correction's Credit Refund is accepted and both keep their value; once the Customer owes a charge, the returned Credit and the Customer's other Credit pay first and the Deposit pays what a staff decision lets it pay; a plan that leaves that debt open while the Deposit keeps money is refused (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-08-59).

Once the Final Settlement is closed, a Lease Deposit forfeiture draft is refused at record (P5S01); a receipt reversal draft is recorded only at READ COMMITTED (55000) (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answers 1 and 4 to Q-2026-10-08-59, approved tightenings).

Inside a return-only correction of a Settlement Deposit Refund confirmed by hand, a return row with another reason than the draft's is refused (23514) and the same row with the draft's reason passes (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-08-59).

Under the hold rule of a return-only Credit correction, a Security Deposit keeps no money while debt stays open, and a Pet Deposit keeps no money while pet damage stays open after its own step even when the Security Deposit pays that pet damage instead; with the Customer's Credit first and the Pet Deposit paying the pet damage, both may keep the rest (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2a, owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-08-59, review round 2).

After closure the one-call return of a Pet Refund-review Refund and the one-call reversal of its return recorded before closure are refused (P5S01, a conflict), also after a return-only correction of the Settlement's Pet Deposit Refund leaves the Pet Deposit holding more than that return; a reversal row or an unlinked return row written directly is refused by the Refund correction check (P5S01); nothing is written (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, owner answer 6 to Q-2026-10-08-55 and the owner instruction of 2026-10-09).

After closure a Pet Refund-review Refund comes back through REFUND_RETURN: a return-only correction writes the verified return under financial.approve, linked first, and the Pet Deposit holds it; a later return with a new Refund runs the DL-032 step and, with no open debt, refunds the Pet Deposit's whole balance; the Settlement row is unchanged and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, owner answer 6 to Q-2026-10-08-55).

A Lease Deposit forfeiture draft is refused at REPEATABLE READ and SERIALIZABLE (55000) and nothing is written; at READ COMMITTED the same call reaches the closure refusal (P5S01) (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, owner answer to Q-2026-10-08-60, approved tightening).

The migration replaces only the returned-Refund Settlement lookup and patches three functions (each new body exactly the old one with its replacements, privileges, owner, SECURITY DEFINER and settings kept); it adds no relation or trigger and is forward-only (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b).

The Refund service reports the closed-Settlement refusal (P5S01) of the one-call verified return and of its reversal as a conflict with a safe message (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, owner answer 6 to Q-2026-10-08-55).

A returned-Refund correction command refuses an aware return date at the edge of the date range, or one whose tzinfo raises, as invalid input (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, 10c-2b-1 review round 3 note).

After a pet noncompliance termination (BR-DEP-022) the kept Pet Deposit's Pet Refund-review Refund returned with a new Refund is accepted and refunds the returned 2,000 to the Customer; a return-only correction leaves 2,000 of pay-back money held on the DL-032 path, which a forfeiture after closure cannot take (P5S01) (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, review round 1; changed and renamed in sub-slice 10c-2b-5 by the owner's pay-back answers to Q-2026-10-09-61, Q-2026-10-10-75 and Q-2026-10-11-84, it was test_a_returned_pet_refund_off_the_dl032_path_is_only_held).

A REPEATABLE READ transaction whose snapshot predates the closure fails with 40001 on the Pet Deposit's serialization guard when it tries the one-call return of a Pet Refund-review Refund or the reversal of its older return after closure; it checks the fail-closed claim of the migration comment, the guard predates the migration (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-2b, security review round 1).

A Credit left by a return-only REFUND_RETURN correction is refunded by a later HELD_VALUE_REFUND correction only after it pays its own Customer's open debt on the Lease (no plan refused), at most what the earlier correction left, a cap this correction's own step application does not lower (owner answer 2 to Q-2026-10-09-63); Staff cannot confirm; a second one is refused when nothing is left; the Settlement row is unchanged and the ledger reconciles (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-3, owner answers 1, 2 and 4 to Q-2026-10-08-55).

Pet Deposit money held after a return-only correction of the Settlement's Pet Deposit Refund is refunded by a HELD_VALUE_REFUND correction through the plan's Deposit Refund step (no plan refused); the earlier correction is then refused (nothing left), also after a second return-only correction brings back more money, with no money or record changed; a correction linked to the second one lets the Pet Deposit pay a new charge, and the audit names the Deposit's owner and every Deposit balance settled (V1-056 sub-slice 10c-2b-3, owner answer 3 to Q-2026-10-07-42, owner answer 1 to Q-2026-10-09-63).
